about.description: VN-SECURITY’ 2026 is the first International Exhibition and Conference on the Security Industry in Vietnam, positioned as an annual forum for security technology and industry. The event focuses on a comprehensive security technology ecosystem, fostering connection, collaboration, and the development of a modern security industry in Vietnam.

section_about.title: About VN-Security'2026
section_about.p1: VN-Security'2026 is the first international exhibition and conference on the security industry held in Vietnam, marking a significant step for Vietnam's security industry on the international map.
section_about.p2: The event brings together leading manufacturers, distributors, and experts in security technology from around the world, creating the largest trade and knowledge-sharing forum in the region.
section_about.p3: With over 20,000m2 of exhibition space at the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center (SECC), VN-Security'2026 promises to deliver a comprehensive experience of modern security technology to over 30,000 visitors.

faq.page_description: Answers to common questions about VN Security 2026

questions.a: VN Security 2026 is the First International Exhibition and Conference on Security Industry in Vietnam, bringing together over 500 exhibitors from 50+ countries, expected to attract 30,000+ industry visitors.

questions.q: When and where is the event?
questions.a: VN Security 2026 will take place from October 15-18, 2026 at the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center (SECC), 799 Nguyen Van Linh, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City.

The event is suitable for security equipment manufacturers and distributors; industry professionals and engineers; government representatives; businesses needing security solutions; and students and researchers in related fields.

questions.q: How do I register to visit?
questions.a: You can register online on the official website or register directly at the registration desk on the event day. Pre-registration will help you save time on check-in.
Visitor registration for the exhibition is completely FREE. However, some workshops and in-depth seminars may require a separate registration fee.
Yes, you can cancel your registration at any time before the event by contacting the organizers via email or hotline.

questions.q: How much does booth rental cost?
questions.a: Booth rental costs depend on location and size. Please contact the organizers for detailed pricing and early bird offers.

questions.q: What is the exhibition registration deadline?
questions.a: Exhibition registration deadline is July 31, 2026. However, registering before March 31, 2026 will receive a 15% discount on booth rental.
Standard booth includes: partitions, signage, tables and chairs, electrical outlets, and basic lighting. Additional services such as internet and AV equipment can be ordered separately.

questions.q: How do I register to attend seminars?
questions.a: After registering as a visitor, you can register for desired seminar sessions through the online registration system. Seats are limited, register early to secure your spot.

questions.q: Can I register as a speaker?
questions.a: Yes, we welcome experts to register as speakers. Please submit your profile and topic proposal through the speaker registration form on the website.
